checked: watch list found: Komdigi rules, scams/phishing, AI/data centres, chips/RAM, consumer phone prices, Big Tech (Nvidia), telco

events.event: Counterpoint Research said the share of Indonesian smartphone sales priced under US$150 fell from 55% in Q3 2025 to 24% in Q3 2026 as RAM prices rose, making phones under Rp2 million hard to find.
events.key_numbers: Under US$150 (about Rp2.7 million) share 55% to 24% (Q3 2025 to Q3 2026) · US$150-249 22% to 33% · US$350-499 6% to 16% · above US$700 3% to 10% · RAM price up 78-100% in a year · example 4GB/64GB phone about Rp1.5 million to about Rp1.8 million · third straight quarter of budget-segment decline · Q3 2026 share Samsung 33%, Xiaomi 21%, Oppo 16%, Infinix 11%, vivo 8%
events.why_it_matters: Cheap phones are disappearing: ordinary buyers now pay more for the same spec.

events.event: Industry Minister Muhammad Sarmuji said electronics prices in Indonesia will inevitably rise as global memory chip prices climbed about 20% quarter on quarter in Q3 2026 on AI demand.
events.key_numbers: Memory chip prices about +20% QoQ in Q3 2026 · may stay high until 2027 · statement 9 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: A minister confirming that phone and electronics prices will rise gives the RAM story official weight.

events.event: Komdigi said 41.49 million mobile subscribers have completed biometric SIM registration, above the year-end target, while the subscriber base fell by about 27 million to about 297 million and operator ARPU rose.
events.key_numbers: 41.49 million biometric registrations · subscribers down about 27 million to about 297 million · operator ARPU up · AI-edited KTP photos tried against checks (Komdigi says detected)
events.why_it_matters: 27 million phone numbers vanished after stricter SIM rules, which touches anyone with a second number.
events.spreading_evidence: detik Inet terpopuler #10; CNBC, Katadata, Bisnis, IDN all covered

events.event: Komdigi's Dany Suwardany said the ministry is building a portal (cekdomain.komdigi.go.id, in trial) where people can check which numbers are registered on their NIK and report suspicious ones for blocking.
events.key_numbers: Check by NIK, NIK+KK or face scan · blocking within max 1x24 hours for valid reports · no launch date, still in trial
events.why_it_matters: Lets people find out whether strangers registered SIMs under their identity. Note: a similar NIK-check platform was cancelled in Oct (CNN Indonesia) over data harvesting, so beware fake lookalike sites.

events.event: CNN Indonesia reported Nvidia is reportedly considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO three days after he resigned, and a petition for his return passed 167,000 signatures with Elon Musk among backers.
events.key_numbers: Petition over 167,000 signatures · resigned 12-13 Nov · 3 days later return considered · Colette Kress interim CEO
events.why_it_matters: The world's most valuable AI chip firm is leaderless right before earnings, which moves AI stocks and chip prices.
events.spreading_evidence: detik Inet terpopuler #17; CNBC, CNN, Katadata multiple items

events.event: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 FY2027 results after US market close on 17 November, its first earnings since Jensen Huang resigned.
events.key_numbers: 17 Nov after US close (about 04:00 WITA 18 Nov) · interim CEO Colette Kress
events.why_it_matters: Result will show whether AI chip demand holds without its founder; results land on the Indonesian morning of 18 Nov.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported large protests against AI data-centre projects in several countries, with a separate piece noting protests spreading from Indonesia to Malaysia and Thailand.
events.key_numbers: Protests in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand (numbers not confirmed)
events.why_it_matters: Backlash against data centres (power, water, land) could slow the AI build-out Indonesia is courting.

events.event: ULA's Vulcan rocket failed to reach orbit because of an engine malfunction, and detik reported about 40 satellites meant to rival Starlink were lost.
events.key_numbers: About 40 satellites lost (per detik) · launch 15-16 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A setback for Starlink's rivals; Starlink stays dominant for Indonesian satellite internet.

events.event: Rockstar's GTA VI is scheduled for release on 19 November 2026, and CNN Indonesia expects workers to call in sick.
events.why_it_matters: The biggest game launch of the year; console and game sales and store traffic follow.
